name: Hollow Men Gather
placementTarget: Rulebook page 14, Infections, rule sticker S, the first empty box under the infect-a-city paragraph.
summary: Title HOLLOW MEN GATHER. If you draw a Hollow Men Gather card, keep drawing until you draw an Infection card with a city on it, and discard any other Hollow Men Gather cards drawn. Add exactly 1 Hollow Men figure to the first Infection card with a city on it. Do not remove a Supply cube or add a Plague cube to that city. If the city already has 3 Hollow Men figures, do not place a 4th figure. Instead, immediately reduce the population of that city by 1. The letter S is the rulebook slot. It is not printed on the sticker.

mechanics.timing: When a Hollow Men Gather card is drawn.
mechanics.effect: Keep drawing until an Infection card with a city on it appears. Discard the extra Gather cards. Put exactly 1 Hollow Men figure in that city and do not perform the normal infect (no Supply cube removed, no Plague cube added). A city that already has 3 figures does not receive a 4th. It immediately loses 1 population instead.
restrictions: Exactly 1 figure, on the first city card drawn.
The population loss for a 4th figure is immediate. It is not saved for Game End.
The Gather card's own text is the short form of this procedure. This sticker adds the supply, plague, and 3-figure cap.
